short_description: This is an invitation to immerse yourself in a peaceful environment and a deeply enriching spagyric practice, combining laboratory work, astrology, and plant medicine. It offers a direct experience of Hermetic principles and a deeper connection to nature and your inner process.
description:
Join us for a ten-day immersion in Portugal that unites **Spagyric laboratory work, astrology, and phytotherapy**, offering a direct experience of how **Hermetic principles** come alive through the healing intelligence of nature — transforming plants into medicine for **body, spirit, and soul**.

Through **philosophy, hands-on practice, storytelling, astrology, and Spagyric phytotherapy**, you will learn to capture the essence of plants and craft remedies that nurture both the physical body and the subtle dimensions of being.

Step by step, you will be guided through the foundations of Spagyric practice: **distilling essential oils and aromatic waters, preparing medicinal wines, purifying salts, and reuniting body, spirit, and soul to make a Spagyric tincture.**

The study of **planetary archetypes and astrological correspondences** will deepen your understanding of timing, energetics, and balance — the scientific and philosophical foundation of the Hermetic principle *“As above, so below.”*

### **What You Will Experience and Lear**n

#### **Part I – Capturing the Soul**

* Essential oil distillation (complete extraction)
* Aromatic waters
* Oleolites (oil infusions)
* Melites (honey infusions)

#### **Parts II & III – Spirit & Body**

* Fermentation of the Spirit & medicinal wines
* Crafting Spagyric tinctures and exploring their unique properties
* Calcination & purification of salts
* Reunification of body, spirit & soul
* Introduction to Spagyric Quintessences and their physical and energetic effects

[More Information](https://stan.store/kermesspagyrics/p/portugal)
title: Spagyric Immersion Portugal
